leadText:
Pokémon: Heritage Collection is a Region 4 DVD set released by in Australia on November 19, 2014. It contains 54 discs with 460 episodes across them combined. Its catalog number is BHE5566. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

It contains all episodes from seasons 1 to 9 of , except Holiday Hi-Jynx, Stage Fight!, and The Mandarin Island Miss Match (which all featured Jynx in its original design). In Region 4 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to standard broadcast seasons, rather than by VIZ Media DVD season.

The discs are contained in a large hand-painted mold. The discs are separated by season, with each of the nine seasons in its own foldable pocket.
